narrative.overview: Marksyte should feel like a clear signal moving through a noisy system: bright, legible and immediately directional. The new bar is white space, bold black typography, bright blue action, soft sky-toned surfaces and large rounded modules that make the journey easy to follow.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue owns action and direction. Soft colors organize context; they do not compete with the CTA.

rules.name: The Air-First Rule
rules.body: Space and tonal contrast establish hierarchy before borders and shadows do.

rules.name: The One-Thought Rule
rules.body: Every headline should communicate one decision, outcome or change—not a list of capabilities.

dos: Do make the first viewport feel like a clear guided journey.
Do show real or clearly labeled illustrative data artifacts.
donts: Don't bring back the warm cream grid or dark-panel-heavy hierarchy.
Don't fill the page with repeated text cards when one visual proof module would explain more.
